function fixture(coords,railCount=2,topFix='through',gates=[]){return{format:'sq-fence-design',version:1,name:'配件測試',nodes:coords.map(([x,z])=>({x,z})),edges:coords.slice(1).map((_,i)=>({...partsApi.defaults,a:i,b:i+1,railCount,topFix,style:gates.includes(i)?'gate':'clamp'}))};}
function quantities(s){return Object.fromEntries(partsApi.accessoryCount(s).items.map(i=>[i.key,i.total]));}

const panEvents={},panElements={},panQueue=new Map();let panDraws=0,panCalls=0;const panSandbox={document:{getElementById:id=>panElements[id]??=(id==='scene'?{getContext:()=>({}),style:{},focus(){},setPointerCapture(){},setAttribute(){},addEventListener:(name,fn)=>panEvents[name]=fn}:{style:{},classList:{toggle(){}},setAttribute(){},textContent:''})},console,coords:e=>({x:e.x,y:e.y}),nodeAt:()=>0,edgeAt:()=>0,draw:()=>panDraws++,sync:()=>{},requestAnimationFrame:fn=>{panCalls++;panQueue.set(panCalls,fn);return panCalls;},cancelAnimationFrame:id=>panQueue.delete(id)};vm.createContext(panSandbox);vm.runInContext(head+js.slice(js.indexOf('const clone='),js.indexOf('function change('))+js.slice(js.indexOf('function updateInteraction('),js.indexOf("canvas.addEventListener('wheel'")),panSandbox);const panBefore=vm.runInContext('JSON.stringify(state)',panSandbox),yawBefore=vm.runInContext('yaw',panSandbox);panEvents.pointerdown({button:0,x:10,y:20,pointerId:1,preventDefault(){}});panEvents.pointermove({x:70,y:60});panEvents.pointermove({x:75,y:62});assert.equal(panCalls,1);assert.equal(panDraws,0);assert.equal(vm.runInContext('pan.x',panSandbox),65);assert.equal(vm.runInContext('pan.y',panSandbox),42);panEvents.pointerup();assert.equal(panDraws,1);assert.equal(panQueue.size,0);assert.equal(vm.runInContext('JSON.stringify(state)',panSandbox),panBefore);assert.equal(vm.runInContext('yaw',panSandbox),yawBefore);assert.equal(vm.runInContext('history.length',panSandbox),0);assert.ok(html.includes('id="panMode"'));console.log('PASS: drag over a post pans entire drawing, exact pixel movement, frame-coalesced redraw, final redraw, no design/camera-angle/history mutation');
